scientific_integrity: Analytical proof derives the limiting law. Numerical tests are finite diagnostics, not proof. Uses the prior exponential representation and acknowledges its source.
scientific_limitations: Fixed ratio c>1 only; convergence is for a uniform-volume sample, not Hausdorff convergence of the full central polytope; no rate or growing-ratio uniformity established.
title: Truncated-exponential bulk geometry of uniform central simplex polytopes
